$comment: fleet-gateway seam (docs/designs/fleet-connections.md section 3): the snapshot the coordinator publishes and the gateway reads, and the call line the gateway spools and the coordinator ingests. See contracts/README.md for the supported keyword subset.

usageTokenSha256.$comment: SHA-256 of the coordinator's own token for GET /v1/usage.

GatewayProvider.$comment: A provider catalogue entry (go/coordinator/providers.go); the gateway reads only these fields.

keyHeader.$comment: Header that carries the key value as is (Google AI x-goog-api-key); absent: Authorization: Bearer <key>.

GatewayUsageSource.$comment: Per-key usage report (reconcile): GET path, and the dotted field holding the number.

inject.$comment: Body fields the gateway adds to every call (Tavily include_usage).

headers.$comment: Fixed request headers, e.g. a provider's opt-in flag.

pathPatterns.$comment: Pattern per {field} of path; a value that does not match is refused before a key is attached. A field without a pattern takes letters, digits, - and _.

adoptMatch.$comment: Primary submitted identity field required for uncertain job adoption; absent returned input stays unknown.

adoptFields.$comment: Additional submitted fields that must be returned unchanged to adopt a job.

usageField.$comment: Dotted reply field holding the usage amount (Google AI usageMetadata.totalTokenCount); absent: usage.<unit>.

usageOnce.$comment: Path field whose value keys the usage: the coordinator counts it once per (connection, value), so repeated polls of one finished job are not counted again.

GatewayUsageWhen.$comment: Usage counts only when this reply field equals the value (Meshy job_status: status SUCCEEDED).

blocked.$comment: Reached pause/stop budgets: "connection" (every call) or a run scope (person:, project:, experiment:).

CallLine.$comment: One provider call: a spool line written by the gateway, and the result of contract.GatewayCall (coordinator api steps, executor connection MCP server), which adds output and leaves the spool-only fields (usage, key fields, startedAt, ms) empty; provider usage stays inside output.

usageKey.$comment: <connection>:<usageOnce value>; set with usage on a usageOnce tool.

output.$comment: In-process call only: the provider's reply body.
